user.title: Connect to your UniFi controller
user.description: Create an API key in UniFi Network under Settings → Control Plane → Integrations. A read-only key is enough.

data_description.url: Address of the UniFi console or Network application, e.g. https://192.168.1.1.
data_description.verify_ssl: UniFi consoles use a self-signed certificate by default; only enable this if the controller has a trusted one.

reauth_confirm.title: UniFi API key rejected
reauth_confirm.description: The controller {url} rejected the API key. Enter a new one.
